summary: TEMA Middleware Phase 3.1 (Auth foundation) independently verified. Build/lint clean, 82 unit tests + 31 e2e tests all pass. OpenAPI paths are exactly [/health, /health/integrations, /me, /ready, /version] with Bearer JWT security scheme. Runtime checks on ports 8120/8121/8122 all match spec: auth-disabled default returns {authenticated:false}; auth-enabled dev provider produces AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED / AUTHENTICATION_FAILED / TOKEN_EXPIRED / 200 valid; correlation id present in headers and echoed; no Authorization/Bearer/secret leakage in /tmp/tema8121.log; production+dev provider refuses to start with the exact required error message; unknown route returns NOT_FOUND.
critical_code_review_comments: AuthenticationService logs auth outcomes without any header/token content — good.
Dev provider correctly refuses production at bootstrap (fail-fast) before serving traffic.
OpenAPI is properly minimal for this phase; only Phase 1/1.5/2 + /me paths exposed.
test_credentials: None required; dev HS256 secret injected via env (>=32 chars).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Standalone NestJS app at /app/tema-middleware (not in supervisor). Build: `yarn build`. Tests: `yarn test`, `yarn test:e2e`. Start manually: `node dist/main.js`. Kill with `pkill -f dist/main.js`. Ports used during test: 8120 (auth off), 8121 (auth on dev), 8122 (prod-safety check, expected to exit 1). Note: when doing shell log-leak greps, ensure env vars are exported in the SAME `execute_bash` call — separate calls do not share env, and an empty `$VAR` alternative in a regex matches every line (false positive).
